Many people in the crowd wear red hats and hold up their phones to film him. The restaurant is decorated with large American flags. Trump walks through the restaurant, announces he is buying hamburgers for everyone, and then approaches the counter to interact with the employees, shaking their hands. He then turns back to the crowd, waves, and gives a thumbs-up as they chant 'USA!'.
